description: Observations that are not retained HTTP entities. 'webfetch' rows are pages read through the session's web retrieval tool, which renders a page to text from a different network egress; they are quotations/link lists, not original bytes, and were made because direct requests from this host returned HTTP 403. 'wayback_cdx' rows are Internet Archive CDX index query results (capture timestamp, original URL, status, MIME, SHA-1 payload digest in base32, record length). Wayback capture timing reflects archive crawl schedules, not the publisher's update cadence.

findings: Results link: 'Election Results' described as 'Results 1998 - current' -> https://www.laramiecountywy.gov/County-Government/Elected-Officials/County-Clerk/Elections/Election-Results
Quoted statement: 'All Wyoming counties use the same election equipment and software—Election Systems & Software (ES&S).'
Page footer: 'Powered by Granicus' (website platform, not a results vendor).
No statement of when or how election-night results are posted.

Heading '2026 Primary Election Official Results' with 8 PDFs under /files/sharedassets/public/v/1/clerk/documents/election-results/2026-primary/ (fed-and-state-election-summary.pdf 65KB, fed-and-state-precinct-summary.pdf 743KB, county-and-city-election-summary.pdf, county-and-city-precinct-summary.pdf, 1-spot-*.pdf, precinct committee people).
Heading '2024 GENERAL ELECTION RESULTS' with 4 PDFs under .../2024-general/official/ (federal-and-state-election-summary.pdf 35KB, federal-and-state-precinct-summary.pdf 401KB, city-and-county-*).
No link labeled unofficial, election night, canvass or recount; no posting or update schedule stated.

'Election Equipment Test Results': 2026 Primary Test -> https://www.laramiecountywy.gov/files/sharedassets/public/v/1/clerk/documents/laramie-county-2026-primary-election-test-deck-results-july-15-16.pdf ; 2026 General Test -> https://www.laramiecountywy.gov/files/sharedassets/public/v/1/clerk/documents/laramie-county-2026-general-election-test-deck-results-september-28.pdf
No election-night results, unofficial-results posting or canvass-date text on the page.
The web retrieval tool also received HTTP 403; no content observed. Wayback captures are used instead.

wayback_cdx.meaning: The 2026 general results page has never been archived; consistent with the current HTTP 404.

wayback_cdx.result_summary: HTTP 404 captures on 2024-11-03 (four, digest FIHOKAHX...); first HTTP 200 capture 2024-11-05T19:47:26Z; 20 distinct 200 captures between 2024-11-06T01:58Z and 2024-11-16T02:28Z, then later captures.
wayback_cdx.meaning: The SOS publishes the general-results year page only around election day; before that the same path returned 404.
Seven distinct payloads were archived; captures between 2024-11-06T08:28Z and 2024-11-10T04:20Z are absent, so intermediate versions (if any) are unobserved.

wayback_cdx.result_summary: Only 2026_Statewide_Senate_Candidates_Summary.pdf (state legislature, 2026-08-19T12:40Z) and 2026_Statewide_Total_Ballots_Cast_Summary.pdf (unofficial digest UHF5... 2026-08-20T03:50Z; official digest PUR5... from 2026-08-28T15:21Z). The 2026_Statewide_Candidates_Summary.pdf with the U.S. Senate primary has no capture before 2026-09-01.
wayback_cdx.meaning: No archived election-night U.S. Senate primary snapshot exists; only a later unofficial ballots-cast version.
Laramie's election-night page state is unobserved for both reference elections.

wayback_cdx.result_summary: Only paths under 2024-general/official/ were captured (earliest 2025-03-08); a 2026-03-10 capture of city-and-county-election-summary.pdf is itself HTTP 403. No unofficial 2024 path was observed; no unofficial path is guessed.
